vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenSSL denial of service via crafted X.509 certificate vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: OpenSSL contains a vulnerability (denial of service via crafted X.509 certificate) that a remote attacker can exploit.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
